85 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionInsertClassStart(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jstring java_string, jboolean is_interface, jboolean is_enum, jboolean /*is_anonymous*/, jobject jToken) {

92  ROSE_ASSERT(outer_scope != NULL);

94  SgClassDeclaration *class_declaration = NULL;
95  SgClassDefinition *class_definition = NULL;
96  SgClassSymbol *class_symbol = lookupClassSymbolInScope(outer_scope, name);

98  class_declaration = isSgClassDeclaration(class_symbol -> get_declaration() -> get_definingDeclaration());

102  }
103  else {
104  class_declaration = SageBuilder::buildJavaDefiningClassDeclaration(outer_scope, name,
105  (is_interface
106  ? SgClassDeclaration::e_java_interface
107  : is_enum
108  ? SgClassDeclaration::e_java_enum
109  : SgClassDeclaration::e_class));
110 
111  setJavaSourcePosition(class_declaration, env, jToken);
112  class_definition = class_declaration -> get_definition();
113 // TODO: Remove this!

115 cout << "Adding class " << class_definition -> get_qualified_name().getString() << " (" << ((unsigned long) class_definition) << ")" << endl; cout.flush();
116 cout << "...in the stack: " << endl;
117 for (std::list<SgScopeStatement*>::iterator i = astJavaScopeStack.begin(); i != astJavaScopeStack.end(); i++) {
118 cout << " "
119 << (isSgClassDefinition(*i) ? isSgClassDefinition(*i) -> get_qualified_name().getString()
120  : isSgFunctionDefinition(*i) ? (isSgFunctionDefinition(*i) -> get_declaration() -> get_name().getString() + "(...)")
121  : (*i) -> class_name())
122 << " ("
123 << ((unsigned long) (*i))
124 << ")"
125 << endl;
126 cout.flush();
127 }
128 */
129  ROSE_ASSERT(class_definition);
130  setJavaSourcePosition(class_definition, env, jToken);
131  }
132 
133  SgScopeStatement *type_space = SageBuilder::buildScopeStatement(class_definition);
134  setJavaSourcePosition(type_space, env, jToken);
135  AstSgNodeAttribute *attribute = (AstSgNodeAttribute *) class_declaration -> getAttribute("type_space");
136  ROSE_ASSERT(attribute);
137  attribute -> setNode(type_space);
138 
139  astJavaScopeStack.push(class_definition); // to contain the class members...
140 }

463  ROSE_ASSERT(outer_scope);

465  SgClassSymbol *class_symbol = lookupClassSymbolInScope(outer_scope, name);
466 // TODO: Remove this!

473  << "; method_index = "
474  << method_index
475  << endl;
476  cout.flush();
477 }
478 */

480  SgClassDeclaration *parameter_declaration = (SgClassDeclaration *) class_symbol -> get_declaration() -> get_definingDeclaration();

498 
499  string type_parameter_bounds_name = "";
500  for (int i = 0, k = num_bounds - 1; i < num_bounds; i++, k--) {
501  SgNamedType *bound_type = isSgNamedType(astJavaComponentStack.popType());

519 // TODO: Remove this!

522  << getTypeName(parameter_type)
523  << " is "
524  << parameter_type -> get_mangled()
525 << endl;
526 cout.flush();
527 */
528  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
529  printf ("Done Updating a Type Parameter \n");
530 }

545 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionBuildClassExtendsAndImplementsSupport(JNIEnv* /*env*/, jclass, jint java_num_type_parameters, jboolean java_has_super_class, jint java_num_interfaces, jobject /*jToken*/) {
546  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
547  printf ("Inside of Java_JavaParser_cactionBuildClassExtendsAndImplementsSupport()\n");
548 
549  int number_of_type_parameters = java_num_type_parameters;
550  bool has_super_class = java_has_super_class;
551  int number_of_interfaces = java_num_interfaces;
552 
553  //
554  // Temporarily pop this type definition off the stack to that we can process its super class and interfaces.
555  // We will push it back when we are done processing this type header.
556  //
557  ROSE_ASSERT( ! astJavaScopeStack.empty());
558  SgClassDefinition *class_definition = isSgClassDefinition(astJavaScopeStack.pop());
559 
560  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0) {
561  ROSE_ASSERT(class_definition != NULL);
562  cout << "Type " << class_definition -> get_qualified_name()
563  << " has "
564  << (has_super_class ? "a super class" : "no super class")
565  << " and "
566  << number_of_interfaces
567  << " interface(s)."
568  << endl;
569  cout.flush();
570  }
571 
572  //
573  // TODO: Need to do this right !!!
574  //
575  // As an SgJavaParameterized type is not associated with a unique declaration but with the declaration of its
576  // base raw type, we need to create an attribute that contains the list of types that extends or must be
577  // implemented by a given base type.
578  //
579  std::list<SgNode *> extension_list;
580 
581  //
582  // Process the interfaces for this type, if any.
583  //
584  for (int i = 0; i < number_of_interfaces; i++) {
585  SgNamedType *type = (SgNamedType *) astJavaComponentStack.popType();
586 // TODO: Remove this!!!
587 /*
588  SgClassType *interface_type = isSgClassType(type);
589  SgJavaParameterizedType *param_interface_type = isSgJavaParameterizedType(type);
590  SgJavaQualifiedType *qualified_interface_type = isSgJavaQualifiedType(type);
591  ROSE_ASSERT(interface_type || param_interface_type || qualified_interface_type);
592 */
593  extension_list.push_front(type); // (interface_type ? (SgNode *) interface_type : (SgNode *) param_interface_type);
594 
595 // TODO: Remove this!!!
596 /*
597  SgDeclarationStatement *declaration = (interface_type
598  ? interface_type -> get_declaration()
599  : param_interface_type
600  ? param_interface_type -> get_declaration()
601  : qualified_interface_type -> get_declaration());
602 */
603  SgClassDeclaration *interface_declaration = isSgClassDeclaration(type -> getAssociatedDeclaration() -> get_definingDeclaration());
604  ROSE_ASSERT(interface_declaration);
605  SgBaseClass *base = new SgBaseClass(interface_declaration);
606  base -> set_parent(class_definition);
607  class_definition -> prepend_inheritance(base);
608  }
609 
610  //
611  // Add Super class to the current Class definition.
612  //
613  if (has_super_class) {
614  SgNamedType *type = (SgNamedType *) astJavaComponentStack.popType();
615 // TODO: Remove this!!!
616 /*
617  SgClassType *class_type = isSgClassType(type);
618  SgJavaParameterizedType *param_class_type = isSgJavaParameterizedType(type);
619  SgJavaQualifiedType *qualified_class_type = isSgJavaQualifiedType(type);
620  ROSE_ASSERT(class_type || param_class_type || qualified_class_type);
621 */
622  extension_list.push_front(type); // (class_type ? (SgNode *) class_type : (SgNode *) param_class_type);
623 
624 // TODO: Remove this!!!
625 /*
626  SgDeclarationStatement *declaration = (class_type ? class_type -> get_declaration() : param_class_type ? param_class_type -> get_declaration() : qualified_class_type -> get_declaration());
627 */
628  SgClassDeclaration *class_declaration = isSgClassDeclaration(type -> getAssociatedDeclaration() -> get_definingDeclaration());
629  ROSE_ASSERT(! class_declaration -> get_explicit_interface()); // must be a class
630  SgBaseClass *base = new SgBaseClass(class_declaration);
631  base -> set_parent(class_definition);
632  class_definition -> prepend_inheritance(base);
633  }
634 
635  if (number_of_type_parameters > 0) {
636  list<SgTemplateParameter *> parameter_list;
637  for (int i = 0; i < number_of_type_parameters; i++) { // Reverse the content of the stack.
638  SgClassDeclaration *parameter_decl = isSgClassDeclaration(astJavaComponentStack.pop());
639  ROSE_ASSERT(parameter_decl != NULL);
640  SgTemplateParameter *parameter = new SgTemplateParameter(parameter_decl->get_type(), NULL);
641  parameter_list.push_front(parameter);
642  }
643 
644  SgTemplateParameterPtrList final_list;
645  while (! parameter_list.empty()) { // Now that we have the parameters in the right order, create the final list.
646  SgTemplateParameter *parameter = parameter_list.front();
647  parameter_list.pop_front();
648  final_list.push_back(parameter);
649  }
650 
651  SgTemplateParameterList *template_parameter_list = new SgTemplateParameterList();
652  template_parameter_list->set_args(final_list);
653  SgClassDeclaration* class_declaration = class_definition->get_declaration();
654  ROSE_ASSERT(class_declaration != NULL);
655  class_declaration->setAttribute("type_parameters", new AstSgNodeAttribute(template_parameter_list));
656  }
657 
658  AstSgNodeListAttribute *attribute = (AstSgNodeListAttribute *) class_definition -> getAttribute("extensions");
659  for (list<SgNode *>::iterator extension = extension_list.begin(); extension != extension_list.end(); extension++) {
660  SgType *type = isSgType(*extension);
661  ROSE_ASSERT(type != NULL);
662  attribute -> addNode(type);
663 // getTypeName(type); // TODO: this is here temporarily to check whether or not this file needs to be fully qualified in this file.
664  }
665 
666 // TODO: Remove this!!!
667 /*
668  class_definition -> setAttribute("extensions", attribute); // TODO: Since declarations are not mapped one-to-one with parameterized types, we need this attribute.
669  SgClassDeclaration *class_declaration = class_definition -> get_declaration();
670  ROSE_ASSERT(class_declaration);
671  string extension_names = getExtensionNames(extension_list, class_declaration, has_super_class);
672 
673  class_definition -> setAttribute("extension_type_names", new AstRegExAttribute(extension_names)); // TODO: Since declarations are not mapped one-to-one with parameterized types, we need this attribute.
674 */
675  astJavaScopeStack.push(class_definition);
676 
677  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
678  printf ("Exiting Java_JavaParser_cactionBuildClassExtendsAndImplementsSupport()\n");
679 }

685 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionBuildClassSupportEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jstring java_string, jint num_class_members, jobject /*jToken*/) {
686  SgName class_name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, java_string);
687 
688  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
689  printf ("Inside of Java_JavaParser_cactionBuildClassSupportEnd: %s \n", class_name.str());
690 
691  ROSE_ASSERT(! astJavaScopeStack.empty());
692 
693  SgClassDefinition *class_definition = astJavaScopeStack.popClassDefinition();
694  ROSE_ASSERT(class_definition);
695 
696 // TODO: Remove this!!!
697 /*
698  for (SgStatement *statement = astJavaComponentStack.popStatement();
699  statement != class_definition;
700  statement = astJavaComponentStack.popStatement()) {
701  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2) {
702  cerr << "(1) Adding statement "
703  << statement -> class_name()
704  << " to an implicit Type Declaration"
705  << endl;
706  cerr.flush();
707  }
708  ROSE_ASSERT(statement != NULL);
709 
710  class_definition -> prepend_statement(statement);
711  }
712 */
713 
714  for (int i = 0; i < num_class_members; i++) {
715  SgDeclarationStatement *declaration = isSgDeclarationStatement(astJavaComponentStack.pop());
716  ROSE_ASSERT(declaration != NULL);
717  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2) {
718  cerr << "(1) Adding declaration "
719  << declaration -> class_name()
720  << " to class "
721  << class_name.getString()
722  << endl;
723  cerr.flush();
724  }
725 
726  class_definition -> prepend_member(declaration);
727  }
728 
729 // TODO: Remove this! 12/09/13
730 // ROSE_ASSERT(astJavaComponentStack.top() == class_definition);
731 // astJavaComponentStack.pop();
732 
733  ROSE_ASSERT(! astJavaScopeStack.empty());
734  SgScopeStatement *type_space = isSgScopeStatement(astJavaScopeStack.pop()); // Remove the type parameter scope temporarily
735  ROSE_ASSERT(type_space);
736 
737  SgScopeStatement *outerScope = astJavaScopeStack.top();
738  astJavaScopeStack.push(type_space); // replate the type parameter scope on the stack.
739 
740  SgClassDeclaration *class_declaration = class_definition -> get_declaration();
741  ROSE_ASSERT(class_declaration);
742 
743  class_declaration -> setAttribute("complete", new AstRegExAttribute(""));
744 
745  //
746  // TODO: Review this because of the package issue and the inability to build a global AST.
747  //
748  ROSE_ASSERT(outerScope != NULL);
749  if ((isSgClassDefinition(outerScope) != NULL) && (isSgJavaPackageDeclaration(isSgClassDefinition(outerScope)->get_declaration()) != NULL)) { // a type in a package?
750  isSgClassDefinition(outerScope)->append_member(class_declaration);
751  }
752  else if ((isSgClassDefinition(outerScope) != NULL) && (isSgJavaPackageDeclaration(isSgClassDefinition(outerScope)->get_declaration()) == NULL)) { // an inner type?
753  ; // Ignore an inner type here as it will be proceessed later when the class member declarations are visited.
754  // See Java_JavaParser_cactionBuildInnerTypeSupport(...).
755  }
756  else if (isSgBasicBlock(outerScope) != NULL) { // a local type declaration?
757  astJavaComponentStack.push(class_declaration);
758  }
759  else { // What is this?
760  cout << "Found class declaration in scope "
761  << outerScope -> class_name()
762  << endl;
763  ROSE_ABORT();
764  }
765 
766  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
767  printf ("Leaving Java_JavaParser_cactionBuildClassSupportEnd: %s \n", class_name.str());
768 }

774 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionUpdateClassSupportEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jstring java_name, jboolean has_super_class, jint num_interfaces, jint num_class_members, jobject /*jToken*/) {

787 cout << "Updating Class "

789 << " containing "
790 << num_class_members
791 << " members and "
792 << num_super_types

796 */

815  if (super_type_list.size() != (size_t)num_super_types)

822  << endl;
823

825  cout << " -> " << super_type_list[i] -> get_base_class() -> get_qualified_name() << endl;

827  }

830 
831  std::list<SgNode *> extension_list;
832  for (int i = 0; i < num_super_types; i++) {
833  SgNamedType *type = (SgNamedType *) astJavaComponentStack.popType();
834  extension_list.push_front(type);
835 // TODO: Remove this!
836 /*
837  SgClassType *class_type = isSgClassType(type);
838  SgJavaParameterizedType *parameterized_type = isSgJavaParameterizedType(type);
839  SgJavaQualifiedType *qualified_type = isSgJavaQualifiedType(type);
840  ROSE_ASSERT(class_type || parameterized_type || qualified_type);
841 
842  SgClassDeclaration *super_declaration = isSgClassDeclaration((class_type
843  ? class_type -> get_declaration()
844  : parameterized_type
845  ? parameterized_type -> get_declaration()
846  : qualified_type -> get_declaration()) -> get_definingDeclaration());
847 */
848  SgClassDeclaration *super_declaration = isSgClassDeclaration(type -> getAssociatedDeclaration() -> get_definingDeclaration());
849 
850  ROSE_ASSERT(super_declaration);
851  SgBaseClass *base_class = super_type_list[i];
852  base_class -> set_base_class(super_declaration);
853  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2) {
854  cerr << "(2) Updating super type "
855  << getTypeName(type)
856  << " ["
857  << i
858  << "] to class "
859  << class_name.getString()
860  << endl;
861  cerr.flush();
862  }
863  }
864 
865  AstSgNodeListAttribute *attribute = (AstSgNodeListAttribute *) class_definition -> getAttribute("extensions");
866  ASSERT_not_null(attribute);
867  if ((size_t)(attribute -> size()) != extension_list.size())
868  {
869  cout << "attribute -> size() = "
870  << attribute -> size()
871  << "; extension_list.size() = "
872  << extension_list.size()
873  << endl;
874  cout.flush();
875  }
876 
877  ROSE_ASSERT((size_t)(attribute -> size()) == extension_list.size());
878 
879  int k = 0;
880  for (list<SgNode *>::iterator extension = extension_list.begin(); extension != extension_list.end(); extension++, k++) {
881  SgType *type = isSgType(*extension);
882  ROSE_ASSERT(type);
883  attribute -> setNode(type, k);
884  }
885 
886 // TODO: Remove this!
887 /*
888  SgClassDeclaration *class_declaration = class_definition -> get_declaration();
889  ROSE_ASSERT(class_declaration);
890  AstRegExAttribute *extension_type_names_attribute = (AstRegExAttribute *) class_definition -> getAttribute("extension_type_names");
891  extension_type_names_attribute -> expression = getExtensionNames(extension_list, class_declaration, has_super_class);
892 */
893 
894  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
895  printf ("Exiting Java_JavaParser_cactionUpdateClassSupportEnd(): %s \n", class_name.str());

1323 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionBuildMethodSupportEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass,

1325  jint method_index,
1326  jboolean java_is_constructor,
1327  jboolean java_is_abstract,
1328  jboolean java_is_native,

1335 
1336  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 1)

1338 
1339  int number_of_type_parameters = java_number_of_type_parameters;
1340  int number_of_arguments = java_number_of_arguments;
1341  bool is_constructor = java_is_constructor,
1342  is_abstract = java_is_abstract,
1343  is_native = java_is_native,
1344  is_compiler_generated = java_is_compiler_generated;
1345 
1346  SgScopeStatement *type_space = isSgScopeStatement(astJavaScopeStack.pop());
1347  ROSE_ASSERT(type_space);
1348 
1349 // TODO: Remove this !!!
1350 // SgFunctionDefinition *method_definition = isSgFunctionDefinition(((AstSgNodeAttribute *) type_space -> getAttribute("method")) -> getNode());
1351 // ROSE_ASSERT(method_definition);
1352 
1353  SgClassDefinition *class_definition = isSgClassDefinition(astJavaScopeStack.top());
1354  ROSE_ASSERT(class_definition);
1355 
1356  //
1357  // There is no reason to distinguish between defining and non-defining declarations in Java...
1358  //
1359  SgMemberFunctionDeclaration *method_declaration = buildDefiningMemberFunction(is_constructor ? "<init>" : method_name, class_definition, number_of_arguments, env, method_location, args_location);
1360  method_declaration -> setAttribute("type_space", new AstSgNodeAttribute(type_space));
1361  setJavaSourcePosition(method_declaration, env, method_location);
1362  ROSE_ASSERT(method_declaration != NULL);
1363  if (is_compiler_generated) {
1364  method_declaration -> setAttribute("compiler-generated", new AstRegExAttribute("")); // TODO: This is needed because the ROSE flag below cannot be tested.
1365  method_declaration -> setCompilerGenerated();
1366  }
1367 
1368  SgFunctionDefinition *method_definition = method_declaration -> get_definition();
1369  ROSE_ASSERT(method_definition);
1370 
1371  if (method_index >= 0) {
1372 // TODO: Remove this !!!
1373 // method_definition -> setAttribute("type_space", new AstSgNodeAttribute(type_space));
1374 // AstSgNodeListAttribute *attribute = (AstSgNodeListAttribute *) class_definition -> getAttribute("method-members-map");
1375 // ROSE_ASSERT(attribute);
1376 // attribute -> setNode(method_definition, method_index);
1377 //
1378 // method_definition -> setAttribute("index", new AstIntAttribute(method_index));
1379 //
1380  AstSgNodeListAttribute *attribute = (AstSgNodeListAttribute *) class_definition -> getAttribute("method-members-map");
1381  ROSE_ASSERT(attribute);
1382  attribute -> setNode(method_definition, method_index);
1383  }
1384 
1385  if (is_constructor) {
1386  method_declaration -> get_specialFunctionModifier().setConstructor();
1387  }
1388  if (is_abstract) {
1389  method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().setJavaAbstract();
1390  }
1391  if (is_native) {
1392  method_declaration -> get_functionModifier().setJavaNative();
1393  }
1394 
1395  if (number_of_type_parameters > 0) {
1396  list<SgTemplateParameter *> parameter_list;
1397  for (int i = 0; i < number_of_type_parameters; i++) { // Reverse the content of the stack.
1398  SgClassDeclaration *parameter_decl = isSgClassDeclaration(astJavaComponentStack.pop());
1399  ROSE_ASSERT(parameter_decl);
1400  SgTemplateParameter *parameter = new SgTemplateParameter(parameter_decl -> get_type(), NULL);
1401  parameter_list.push_front(parameter);
1402  }
1403 
1404  SgTemplateParameterPtrList final_list;
1405  while (! parameter_list.empty()) { // Now that we have the parameters in the right order, create the final list.
1406  SgTemplateParameter *parameter = parameter_list.front();
1407  parameter_list.pop_front();
1408  final_list.push_back(parameter);
1409  }
1410 
1411  SgTemplateParameterList *template_parameter_list = new SgTemplateParameterList();
1412  template_parameter_list -> set_args(final_list);
1413  method_declaration -> setAttribute("type_parameters", new AstSgNodeAttribute(template_parameter_list));
1414  }
1415 
1416  // TODO: We need the next 3 lines for EDG4 [DONE]

1418  ROSE_ASSERT(nondefining_method_declaration);
1419  nondefining_method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().set_modifier(method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().get_modifier());
1420 
1421  astJavaComponentStack.push(method_declaration);
1422 // TODO: Remove this !!!
1423 /*
1424 if (method_name.getString().compare("analyzeMethod") == 0){
1425 cout << "In class "
1426 << class_definition -> get_qualified_name().getString()
1427 << ", inserted analyzeMethod(";
1428 vector<SgInitializedName *> args = method_declaration -> get_args();
1429 for (int k = 0; k < args.size(); k++) {
1430 SgType *type = args[k] -> get_type();
1431 if (k > 0) cout << ", ";
1432 cout << getTypeName(type);
1433 }
1434 cout << ")" << endl;
1435 }
1436 */
1437  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 1)
1438  printf ("Exiting BuildMethodSupport for name = %s \n", method_name.str());
1439 }

2296 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionTypeDeclaration(JNIEnv *env, jclass,
2297  jstring java_package_name,
2298  jstring java_type_name,

2301  jboolean java_is_annotation_interface,
2302  jboolean java_is_interface,
2303  jboolean java_is_enum,
2304  jboolean java_is_abstract,
2305  jboolean java_is_final,
2306  jboolean java_is_private,
2307  jboolean java_is_public,
2308  jboolean java_is_protected,
2309  jboolean java_is_static,
2310  jboolean java_is_strictfp,
2311  jobject /*jToken*/)
2312 {
2313  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
2314  printf ("Build a SgClassDeclaration \n");
2315 
2316  // We could provide a constructor for "SgName" that takes a "jstring". This might help support a simpler interface.
2317  SgName package_name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, java_package_name),
2318  type_name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, java_type_name);
2319 
2320 // TODO: Remove this
2321 /*
2322 cout << "Here 6 with "
2323  << "; package_name = " << package_name
2324  << "; type_name = " << type_name
2325  << endl;
2326 cout.flush();
2327 */
2328  SgType *type = lookupTypeByName(package_name, type_name, 0 /* not an array - number of dimensions is 0 */);
2329 
2330  bool is_annotation_interface = java_is_annotation_interface;
2331  bool is_interface = java_is_interface;
2332  bool is_enum = java_is_enum;
2333 
2334  bool is_abstract = java_is_abstract;
2335  bool is_final = java_is_final;
2336  bool is_private = java_is_private;
2337  bool is_public = java_is_public;
2338  bool is_protected = java_is_protected;
2339  bool is_static = java_is_static;
2340  bool is_strictfp = java_is_strictfp;
2341 
2342  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
2343  printf ("Build class type: name = %s \n", type_name.str());
2344 
2345  ROSE_ASSERT(astJavaScopeStack.top() != NULL);
2346 
2347  SgClassDeclaration *class_declaration = (SgClassDeclaration *) type -> getAssociatedDeclaration() -> get_definingDeclaration();
2348  ROSE_ASSERT(class_declaration);
2349  SgClassDefinition *class_definition = class_declaration -> get_definition();
2350  ROSE_ASSERT(class_definition);
2351 
2352  if (num_annotations > 0) {
2353  AstSgNodeListAttribute *annotations_attribute = new AstSgNodeListAttribute();
2354  for (int i = num_annotations - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
2355  SgExpression *annotation = astJavaComponentStack.popExpression();
2356  annotation -> set_parent(class_declaration);
2357  annotations_attribute -> setNode(annotation, i);
2358  }
2359  class_declaration -> setAttribute("annotations", annotations_attribute);
2360  }
2361 
2362  class_declaration -> setAttribute("sourcefile", new AstSgNodeAttribute(::currentSourceFile));
2363  class_declaration -> set_explicit_annotation_interface(is_annotation_interface); // Identify whether or not this is an annotation interface.
2364  class_declaration -> set_explicit_interface(is_annotation_interface || is_interface); // Identify whether or not this is an interface.
2365  class_declaration -> set_explicit_enum(is_enum); // Identify whether or not this is an enum.
2366 
2367  if (is_abstract && (! is_annotation_interface) && (! is_interface) && (! is_enum)) // Enum should not be marked as abstract; Interfaces need not be marked as abstract
2368  class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().setJavaAbstract();
2369  else class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().unsetJavaAbstract();
2370  if (is_final && (! is_enum)) // Enum should not be marked as final
2371  class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().setFinal();
2372  else class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().unsetFinal();
2373  if (is_strictfp)
2374  {
2375  ; // charles4 - TODO: there is currently no place to hang this information.
2376  }
2377 
2378  class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().set_modifier(SgAccessModifier::e_unknown);
2379  if (is_private) {
2380  class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setPrivate();
2381  }
2382  if (is_public) {
2383  class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setPublic();
2384  }
2385  if (is_protected) {
2386  class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setProtected();
2387  }
2388 
2389  class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_storageModifier().set_modifier(SgStorageModifier::e_unknown);
2390  if (is_static && (! is_annotation_interface) && (! is_interface)) { // Interfaces need not be marked as static
2391  class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_storageModifier().setStatic();
2392  }
2393 
2394  // TODO: We need the next 4 lines for EDG4 [DONE]
2395  SgClassDeclaration *nondefining_class_declaration = isSgClassDeclaration(class_declaration -> get_firstNondefiningDeclaration());
2396  ROSE_ASSERT(nondefining_class_declaration);
2397  nondefining_class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().set_modifier(class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().get_modifier());
2398  ROSE_ASSERT(nondefining_class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().get_modifier() == class_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().get_modifier());
2399 
2400  //
2401  //
2402  //
2403  AstSgNodeListAttribute *extension_names_attribute = (AstSgNodeListAttribute *) class_definition -> getAttribute("extensions");
2404  ROSE_ASSERT(extension_names_attribute);
2405  string extension_names = getExtensionNames(extension_names_attribute -> getNodeList(), class_declaration, has_super_class);
2406  AstRegExAttribute *extension_type_names_attribute = (AstRegExAttribute *) class_definition -> getAttribute("extension_type_names");
2407  ROSE_ASSERT(extension_type_names_attribute);
2408  extension_type_names_attribute -> expression = extension_names;
2409 
2410  AstSgNodeAttribute *type_space_attribute = (AstSgNodeAttribute *) class_declaration -> getAttribute("type_space");
2411  ROSE_ASSERT(type_space_attribute);
2412  SgScopeStatement *type_space = (SgScopeStatement *) type_space_attribute -> getNode();
2413  astJavaScopeStack.push(type_space); // Push the type parameters scope for this type onto the stack.
2414  astJavaScopeStack.push(class_definition); // Open new scope for this type.
2415  astJavaComponentStack.push(class_definition); // To mark the end of the list of components in this type.
2416 
2417  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
2418  astJavaScopeStack.top() -> get_file_info() -> display("source position in Java_JavaParser_cactionTypeDeclaration(): debug");
2419 
2420  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
2421  printf ("Leaving Java_JavaParser_cactionTypeDeclaration() \n");
2422 }

2584 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionConstructorDeclarationHeader(JNIEnv *env, jclass,
2585  jstring java_string,
2586  jboolean java_is_public,
2587  jboolean java_is_protected,
2588  jboolean java_is_private,
2589  jint /*java_numberOfTypeParameters*/,
2590  jint /*java_numberOfArguments*/,
2591  jint java_numberOfThrownExceptions,
2592  jobject jToken) {
2593  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
2594  printf ("End of SgMemberFunctionDeclaration (constructor) \n");
2595 
2596  SgName name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, java_string);
2597  bool is_public = java_is_public;
2598  bool is_protected = java_is_protected;
2599  bool is_private = java_is_private;
2600 
2601  // DQ (7/31/2011): Add more precise handling of the statement stack.
2602  // This does not count (include) explicit constructor calls...
2603 
2604  int numberOfThrownExceptions = java_numberOfThrownExceptions;
2605 
2606  //
2607  // Pop the exception types; reverse the list of exception types; create an output string of the names of the tyoes.
2608  //
2609  SgTypePtrList exception_list;
2610  for (int i = 0; i < numberOfThrownExceptions; i++) { // Pop the Thrown types
2611  SgType *type = astJavaComponentStack.popType();
2612  exception_list.push_back(type);
2613 
2614  }
2615  for (int i = 0, k = numberOfThrownExceptions - 1; i < k; i++, k--) { // reverse the list to restore the original order
2616  SgType *temp = exception_list[i];
2617  exception_list[i] = exception_list[k];
2618  exception_list[k] = temp;
2619  }
2620  string exceptions = "";
2621  for (int i = 0; i < numberOfThrownExceptions; i++) {
2622  if (i > 0)
2623  exceptions += ", ";
2624  exceptions += getTypeName(exception_list[i]);
2625  }
2626 
2627  SgFunctionDefinition *constructor_definition = isSgFunctionDefinition(astJavaScopeStack.top());
2628  ROSE_ASSERT(constructor_definition -> get_body() != NULL);
2629  astJavaScopeStack.push(constructor_definition -> get_body());
2630  ROSE_ASSERT(astJavaScopeStack.top() -> get_parent() != NULL);
2631 
2632  setJavaSourcePosition(constructor_definition -> get_body(), env, jToken);
2633 
2634  SgFunctionDeclaration *constructor_declaration = constructor_definition -> get_declaration();
2635  constructor_declaration -> set_exceptionSpecification(exception_list);
2636  if (exceptions.size()) {
2637  constructor_declaration -> setAttribute("exception", new AstRegExAttribute(exceptions));
2638  }
2639 
2640  // Since this is a constructor, set it explicitly as such.
2641  constructor_declaration -> get_specialFunctionModifier().setConstructor();
2642 
2643  // By default, the access modifier is set to unknown
2644  constructor_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().set_modifier(SgAccessModifier::e_unknown);
2645 
2646  // Set the access modifiers (shared between C++ and Java).
2647  if (is_public) {
2648  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
2649  printf ("Setting modifier as Public \n");
2650  constructor_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setPublic();
2651  }
2652  else if (is_protected) {
2653  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
2654  printf ("Setting modifier as Protected \n");
2655  constructor_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setProtected();
2656  }
2657  else if (is_private) {
2658  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
2659  printf ("Setting modifier as Private \n");
2660  constructor_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setPrivate();
2661  }
2662 
2663  // TODO: We need the next 3 lines for EDG4 [DONE]
2664  SgMemberFunctionDeclaration *nondefining_constructor_declaration = isSgMemberFunctionDeclaration(constructor_declaration -> get_firstNondefiningDeclaration());
2665  ROSE_ASSERT(nondefining_constructor_declaration);
2666  nondefining_constructor_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().set_modifier(constructor_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().get_modifier());
2667 }

2670 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionConstructorDeclarationEnd(JNIEnv* /*env*/, jclass, jint num_annotations, jint num_statements, jobject /*jToken*/) {
2671  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
2672  printf ("End of SgMemberFunctionDeclaration (constructor) \n");
2673 
2674  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
2675  printf ("cactionConstructorDeclarationEnd(): number of statements = %d\n", num_statements);
2676 
2677  // Pop the constructor body...
2678  ROSE_ASSERT(! astJavaScopeStack.empty());
2679  SgBasicBlock *constructor_body = astJavaScopeStack.popBasicBlock();
2680  for (int i = 0; i < num_statements; i++) {
2681  SgStatement *statement = astJavaComponentStack.popStatement();
2682  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2) {
2683  cerr << "(3) Adding statement "
2684  << statement -> class_name()
2685  << " to a constructor declaration block"
2686  << endl;
2687  cerr.flush();
2688  }
2689  constructor_body -> prepend_statement(statement);
2690  }
2691 
2692  SgFunctionDefinition *constructor_definition = astJavaScopeStack.popFunctionDefinition();
2693  SgMemberFunctionDeclaration *constructor_declaration = isSgMemberFunctionDeclaration(constructor_definition -> get_declaration());
2694 
2695  if (num_annotations > 0) {
2696  AstSgNodeListAttribute *annotations_attribute = new AstSgNodeListAttribute();
2697  for (int i = num_annotations - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
2698  SgExpression *annotation = astJavaComponentStack.popExpression();
2699  annotation->set_parent(constructor_declaration);
2700  annotations_attribute -> setNode(annotation, i);
2701  }
2702  ROSE_ASSERT(constructor_declaration != NULL);
2703  constructor_declaration -> setAttribute("annotations", annotations_attribute);
2704  }
2705 
2706  SgScopeStatement *type_space = isSgScopeStatement(astJavaScopeStack.pop());
2707  ROSE_ASSERT(type_space);
2708 }

2795  if (qualification != NULL) {

2799  SgDeclarationStatement *declaration = class_type -> get_declaration() -> get_definingDeclaration();

2801  class_definition = isSgClassDefinition(class_declaration -> get_definition());
2802  ROSE_ASSERT(class_definition);

2816  //

2818  //
2819 // TODO: Remove this

2929 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionMethodDeclarationHeader(JNIEnv *env, jclass,
2930  jstring java_string,
2931  jboolean java_is_abstract,
2932  jboolean java_is_native,
2933  jboolean java_is_static,
2934  jboolean java_is_final,
2935  jboolean java_is_synchronized,
2936  jboolean java_is_public,
2937  jboolean java_is_protected,
2938  jboolean java_is_private,
2939  jboolean java_is_strictfp,
2940  jint /*java_numberOfTypeParameters*/,
2941  jint /*java_numberOfArguments*/,
2942  jint java_numberOfThrownExceptions,
2943  jobject jToken) {
2944  SgName name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, java_string);
2945 
2946  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
2947  printf ("Build Method Header for method %s\n", name.getString().c_str());
2948 
2949  bool isAbstract = java_is_abstract;
2950  bool isNative = java_is_native;
2951  bool isStatic = java_is_static;
2952  bool isFinal = java_is_final;
2953  bool isSynchronized = java_is_synchronized;
2954  bool isPublic = java_is_public;
2955  bool isProtected = java_is_protected;
2956  bool isPrivate = java_is_private;
2957  bool isStrictfp = java_is_strictfp;
2958 
2959  int numberOfThrownExceptions = java_numberOfThrownExceptions;
2960 
2961  //
2962  // Pop the exception types; reverse the list of exception types; create an output string of the names of the tyoes.
2963  //
2964  SgTypePtrList exception_list;
2965  for (int i = 0; i < numberOfThrownExceptions; i++) { // Pop the Thrown types
2966  SgType *type = astJavaComponentStack.popType();
2967  exception_list.push_back(type);
2968 
2969  }
2970  for (int i = 0, k = numberOfThrownExceptions - 1; i < k; i++, k--) { // reverse the list to restore the original order
2971  SgType *temp = exception_list[i];
2972  exception_list[i] = exception_list[k];
2973  exception_list[k] = temp;
2974  }
2975  string exceptions = "";
2976  for (int i = 0; i < numberOfThrownExceptions; i++) {
2977 // TODO: Remove this
2978 /*
2979  SgClassType *c_type = isSgClassType(exception_list[i]);
2980  SgJavaParameterizedType *p_type = isSgJavaParameterizedType(exception_list[i]);
2981  SgJavaQualifiedType *q_type = isSgJavaQualifiedType(exception_list[i]);
2982  string throw_name = (c_type ? getTypeName(c_type)
2983  : p_type ? getTypeName(p_type)
2984  : getTypeName(q_type));
2985  ROSE_ASSERT(c_type || p_type || q_type);
2986 
2987  exceptions += throw_name;
2988 */
2989 
2990  if (i > 0)
2991  exceptions += ", ";
2992  exceptions += getTypeName(exception_list[i]);
2993  }
2994 
2995 // TODO: Remove this
2996 /*
2997  for (int i = 0; i < numberOfArguments; i++) { // Pop the argument types
2998  SgType *type = astJavaComponentStack.popType();
2999 cout << "Popping argument of type "
3000  << getTypeName(type)
3001  << " for method "
3002  << name.getString()
3003 << endl;
3004 cout.flush();
3005  }
3006 */
3007 
3008  //
3009  //
3010  //
3011  SgFunctionDefinition *method_definition = isSgFunctionDefinition(astJavaScopeStack.top());
3012  ROSE_ASSERT(method_definition -> get_body() != NULL);
3013  astJavaScopeStack.push(method_definition -> get_body());
3014  ROSE_ASSERT(astJavaScopeStack.top() -> get_parent() != NULL);
3015 
3016  setJavaSourcePosition(method_definition -> get_body(), env, jToken);
3017 
3018  SgFunctionDeclaration *method_declaration = method_definition -> get_declaration();
3019  method_declaration -> set_exceptionSpecification(exception_list);
3020  if (exceptions.size()) {
3021  method_declaration -> setAttribute("exception", new AstRegExAttribute(exceptions));
3022  }
3023 
3024  // By default, the access modifier is set to unknown
3025  method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().set_modifier(SgAccessModifier::e_unknown);
3026 
3027  // Set the Java specific modifiers
3028  if (isAbstract) {
3029  method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().setJavaAbstract();
3030  }
3031 
3032  // Set the Java specific modifiers
3033  if (isNative) {
3034  method_declaration -> get_functionModifier().setJavaNative();
3035  }
3036 
3037  // Set the specific modifier, this modifier is common to C/C++.
3038  if (isStatic) {
3039  method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_storageModifier().setStatic();
3040  }
3041 
3042  // Set the modifier (shared between PHP and Java).
3043  if (isFinal) {
3044  method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().setFinal();
3045  }
3046 
3047  if (isSynchronized) {
3048  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
3049  printf ("Setting modifier as Synchronized \n");
3050  method_declaration -> get_functionModifier().setJavaSynchronized();
3051  }
3052 
3053  // Set the access modifiers (shared between C++ and Java).
3054  if (isPublic) {
3055  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
3056  printf ("Setting modifier as Public \n");
3057  method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setPublic();
3058  }
3059 
3060  if (isProtected) {
3061  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
3062  printf ("Setting modifier as Protected \n");
3063  method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setProtected();
3064  }
3065 
3066  if (isPrivate) {
3067  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
3068  printf ("Setting modifier as Private \n");
3069  method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setPrivate();
3070  }
3071 
3072  // Set the Java specific modifier for strict floating point (defined for functions).
3073  if (isStrictfp) {
3074  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
3075  printf ("Setting modifier as strictfp \n");
3076  method_declaration -> get_functionModifier().setJavaStrictfp();
3077  }
3078  // TODO: We need the next 3 lines for EDG4 [DONE]
3079  SgMemberFunctionDeclaration *nondefining_method_declaration = isSgMemberFunctionDeclaration(method_declaration -> get_firstNondefiningDeclaration());
3080  ROSE_ASSERT(nondefining_method_declaration);
3081  nondefining_method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().set_modifier(method_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().get_modifier());
3082 
3083  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
3084  printf ("Leaving Build Method header for method %s\n", name.getString().c_str());
3085 }

3131 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionTypeParameterReference(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jstring java_package_name, jstring java_type_name, jint method_index, jstring java_type_parameter_name, jobject /*jToken*/) {
3132  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
3133  printf ("Inside cactionTypeParameterReference\n");
3134 
3135  SgName type_parameter_name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, java_type_parameter_name);
3136 
3137  SgName package_name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, java_package_name),
3138  type_name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, java_type_name);
3139 // TODO: Remove this
3140 //cout << "Here 8" << endl;
3141 //cout.flush();
3142  SgType *enclosing_type = lookupTypeByName(package_name, type_name, 0 /* not an array - number of dimensions is 0 */);
3143  ROSE_ASSERT(enclosing_type);
3144  SgClassDeclaration *class_declaration = isSgClassDeclaration(enclosing_type -> getAssociatedDeclaration() -> get_definingDeclaration());
3145  ROSE_ASSERT(class_declaration);
3146  SgClassDefinition *class_definition = class_declaration -> get_definition();
3147  ROSE_ASSERT(class_definition);
3148 
3149  //
3150  // Look in the type parameter scopes for the type in question.
3151  //
3152  SgClassSymbol *class_symbol = NULL;
3153  if (method_index >= 0) { // The type parameter is enclosed in a method in the enclosing type?
3154  AstSgNodeListAttribute *attribute = (AstSgNodeListAttribute *) class_definition -> getAttribute("method-members-map");
3155  ROSE_ASSERT(attribute);

3324 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionCatchArgumentEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jint num_annotations, jstring java_argument_name, jint num_types, jboolean java_is_final, jobject jToken) {
3325  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
3326  printf ("Build a function argument \n");
3327 
3328  SgName argument_name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, java_argument_name);
3329 
3330  bool is_final = java_is_final;
3331 
3332  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
3333  printf ("argument argument_name = %s \n", argument_name.str());
3334 
3335  ROSE_ASSERT(num_types > 0);
3336  SgType *argument_type = (num_types == 1 ? astJavaComponentStack.popType() : new SgJavaUnionType());
3337  if (num_types > 1) {
3338  SgJavaUnionType *union_type = isSgJavaUnionType(argument_type);
3339  SgTypePtrList type_list;
3340  type_list.resize(num_types);
3341 
3342  //
3343  // Pop the component types and place them in the list in the proper order.
3344  //
3345  for (int i = num_types - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
3346  type_list[i] = astJavaComponentStack.popType();
3347  }
3348  union_type -> set_type_list(type_list);
3349  }
3350  ROSE_ASSERT(argument_type);
3351 
3352  //
3353  // Create a variable declaration for the Catch Block parameter ... Make sure that it is inserted
3354  // in the proper scope.
3355  //
3356  SgCatchOptionStmt *catch_option_stmt = isSgCatchOptionStmt(astJavaScopeStack.top());
3357  ROSE_ASSERT(catch_option_stmt);
3358  SgVariableDeclaration *variable_declaration = SageBuilder::buildVariableDeclaration(argument_name, argument_type, NULL, catch_option_stmt);
3359  variable_declaration -> set_parent(catch_option_stmt);
3360  setJavaSourcePosition(variable_declaration, env, jToken);
3361  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setUnknown(); // make sure that all the access flags are off!!!
3362  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_storageModifier().setUnknown(); // make sure that all the storage flags are off!!!
3363  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_typeModifier().setUnknown(); // make sure that all the type flags are off!!!
3364  if (is_final) {
3365  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().setFinal();
3366  }
3367 
3368  ROSE_ASSERT(variable_declaration -> get_variables().size() == 1);
3369  SgInitializedName *init_name = variable_declaration -> get_variables()[0];
3370 // TODO: Remove this!
3371 //cout << "Catch argument type " << getTypeName(argument_type)
3372 //<< endl;
3373 //cout.flush();
3374  init_name -> setAttribute("type", new AstRegExAttribute(getTypeName(argument_type)));
3375 
3376 
3377  if (num_annotations > 0) {
3378  AstSgNodeListAttribute *annotations_attribute = new AstSgNodeListAttribute();
3379  for (int i = num_annotations - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
3380  SgExpression *annotation = astJavaComponentStack.popExpression();
3381  annotation -> set_parent(variable_declaration);
3382  annotations_attribute -> setNode(annotation, i);
3383  }
3384  variable_declaration -> setAttribute("annotations", annotations_attribute);
3385  }
3386 
3387  catch_option_stmt -> set_condition(variable_declaration);
3388  variable_declaration -> set_parent(catch_option_stmt);
3389 }

4091 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionBinaryExpressionEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jint java_operator_kind, jobject jToken) {
4092  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4093  printf ("Build an Binary Expression End \n");
4094 
4095  // These are the operator code values directly from ECJ.
4096  enum ops {
4097  ERROR_OPERATOR = 0, // This is not a ECJ value
4098  AND = 2,
4099  DIVIDE = 9,
4100  GREATER = 6,
4101  GREATER_EQUAL = 7,
4102  LEFT_SHIFT = 10,
4103  LESS = 4,
4104  LESS_EQUAL = 5,
4105  MINUS = 13,
4106  MULTIPLY = 15,
4107  OR = 3,
4108  PLUS = 14,
4109  REMAINDER = 16,
4110  RIGHT_SHIFT = 17,
4111  UNSIGNED_RIGHT_SHIFT = 19,
4112  XOR = 8,
4113  OR_OR = 100, // Handled by separate function
4114  AND_AND = 101, // Handled by separate function
4115  LAST_OPERATOR
4116  };
4117 
4118  // printf ("PLUS = %d \n", PLUS);
4119 
4120  int operator_kind = java_operator_kind;
4121  // printf ("operator_kind = %d \n", operator_kind);
4122 
4123  switch(operator_kind) {
4124  // Operator codes used by the BinaryExpression in ECJ.
4125  case LESS: binaryExpressionSupport<SgLessThanOp>(); break;
4126  case LESS_EQUAL: binaryExpressionSupport<SgLessOrEqualOp>(); break;
4127  case GREATER: binaryExpressionSupport<SgGreaterThanOp>(); break;
4128  case GREATER_EQUAL: binaryExpressionSupport<SgGreaterOrEqualOp>(); break;
4129  case AND: binaryExpressionSupport<SgBitAndOp>(); break;
4130  case OR: binaryExpressionSupport<SgBitOrOp>(); break;
4131  case XOR: binaryExpressionSupport<SgBitXorOp>(); break;
4132  case DIVIDE: binaryExpressionSupport<SgDivideOp>(); break;
4133  case MINUS: binaryExpressionSupport<SgSubtractOp>(); break;
4134  case PLUS: binaryExpressionSupport<SgAddOp>(); break;
4135  case MULTIPLY: binaryExpressionSupport<SgMultiplyOp>(); break;
4136  case RIGHT_SHIFT: binaryExpressionSupport<SgRshiftOp>(); break;
4137  case LEFT_SHIFT: binaryExpressionSupport<SgLshiftOp>(); break;
4138  case REMAINDER: binaryExpressionSupport<SgModOp>(); break;
4139 
4140  // This may have to handled special in ROSE. ROSE does not represent the semantics,
4141  // and so this support my require a special operator to support Java in ROSE. For
4142  // now we will use the more common SgRshiftOp.
4143  case UNSIGNED_RIGHT_SHIFT: binaryExpressionSupport<SgJavaUnsignedRshiftOp>(); break;
4144 
4145  // These are handled through separate functions (not a BinaryExpression in ECJ).
4146  // case OR_OR: ROSE_ASSERT(false); break;
4147  // case AND_AND: ROSE_ASSERT(false); break;
4148 
4149  default:
4150  //
4151  // If this file was not already tagged as an erroneous file, do so now.
4152  //
4153  if (! ::currentSourceFile -> attributeExists("error")) {
4154  ::currentSourceFile -> setAttribute("error", new AstRegExAttribute("Illegal use of a binary operator"));
4155  }
4156 
4157  cout << "Error: default reached in cactionBinaryExpressionEnd() operator_kind = " << operator_kind << endl;
4158  cout.flush();
4159  binaryExpressionSupport<SgAddOp>(); // Any operator so that we can "keep going" !!! EROSE_ASSERT(false);
4160  }
4161 
4162  setJavaSourcePosition((SgLocatedNode *) astJavaComponentStack.top(), env, jToken);
4163 }

4169 
4170 // TODO: Remove this !!!
4171 /*
4172  // There could be a conditional from an IF statement on the stack.

4174 
4175  // If there is an expression on the expression stack and an SgIfStmt on the scope stack then
4176  // this might be a good time to associate the conditional with the SgIfStmt and have a more

4178

4186  SgNullStatement *nullStatement = isSgNullStatement(ifStatement -> get_true_body());
4187  if (nullStatement != NULL) {

4196  delete nullStatement;

4198  else {
4199 cout << "Adding false if block"
4200  << endl;
4201 cout.flush();
4202  // Set the false body
4203  block = SageBuilder::buildBasicBlock();
4204  ROSE_ASSERT(block != NULL);
4205  ifStatement -> set_false_body(block);
4206  }
4207  }
4208  else if (isSgForStatement(astJavaScopeStack.top())) {
4209  // DQ (7/30/2011): Handle the case of a block after a SgForStatement
4210  // Because we build the SgForStatement on the stack and then the cactionBlock
4211  // function is called, we have to detect and fixup the SgForStatement.
4212  SgForStatement *forStatement = (SgForStatement*) astJavaScopeStack.top();
4213  SgNullStatement *nullStatement = isSgNullStatement(forStatement -> get_loop_body());
4214  if (nullStatement != NULL) {
4215  block = SageBuilder::buildBasicBlock();
4216  ROSE_ASSERT(block != NULL);
4217  forStatement -> set_loop_body(block);
4218  delete nullStatement;
4219  }
4220  }
4221  else {
4222  block = SageBuilder::buildBasicBlock();
4223  }
4224  ROSE_ASSERT(block != NULL);
4225 */
4226 
4227  SgBasicBlock *block = SageBuilder::buildBasicBlock();
4228  block -> set_parent(astJavaScopeStack.top());
4229  setJavaSourcePosition(block, env, jToken);
4230 
4231  astJavaScopeStack.push(block);
4232 
4233  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4234  printf ("Done Building an SgBasicBlock scope \n");
4235 }

4238 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionBlockEnd(JNIEnv* /*env*/, jclass, jint java_numberOfStatements, jobject /*jToken*/) {
4239  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4240  printf ("Pop the current SgBasicBlock scope off the scope stack...\n");
4241 
4242  int numberOfStatements = java_numberOfStatements;
4243 
4244  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4245  printf ("In cactionBlockEnd(): numberOfStatements = %d \n", numberOfStatements);
4246 
4247  ROSE_ASSERT(! astJavaScopeStack.empty());
4248 
4249  // DQ (7/30/2011): Take the block off of the scope stack and put it onto the statement stack so that we can
4250  // process either blocks of other statements uniformally.
4251  SgBasicBlock *body = astJavaScopeStack.popBasicBlock();
4252  for (int i = 0; i < numberOfStatements; i++) {
4253  SgStatement *statement = astJavaComponentStack.popStatement();
4254  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2) {
4255  cerr << "(5) Adding statement "
4256  << statement -> class_name()
4257  << " to a block"
4258  << endl;
4259  cerr.flush();
4260  }
4261  body -> prepend_statement(statement);
4262  }
4263 
4264  astJavaComponentStack.push(body);
4265 }

4444 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionCompoundAssignmentEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jint java_operator_kind, jobject jToken) {
4445  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
4446  printf ("Inside of Java_JavaParser_cactionCompoundAssignmentEnd() \n");
4447 
4448  // These are the operator code values directly from ECJ.
4449  enum ops // NO_STRINGIFY
4450  {
4451  ERROR_OPERATOR = 0, // This is not a ECJ value
4452  AND = 2,
4453  DIVIDE = 9,
4454  LEFT_SHIFT = 10,
4455  MINUS = 13,
4456  MULTIPLY = 15,
4457  OR = 3,
4458  PLUS = 14,
4459  REMAINDER = 16,
4460  RIGHT_SHIFT = 17,
4461  UNSIGNED_RIGHT_SHIFT = 19,
4462  XOR = 8,
4463  LAST_OPERATOR
4464  };
4465 
4466  int operator_kind = java_operator_kind;
4467  // printf ("operator_kind = %d \n", operator_kind);
4468 
4469  switch(operator_kind) {
4470  // Operator codes used by the CompoundAssignment in ECJ.
4471 
4472  case PLUS: binaryExpressionSupport<SgPlusAssignOp>(); break;
4473  case MINUS: binaryExpressionSupport<SgMinusAssignOp>(); break;
4474  case DIVIDE: binaryExpressionSupport<SgDivAssignOp>(); break;
4475  case MULTIPLY: binaryExpressionSupport<SgMultAssignOp>(); break;
4476  case OR: binaryExpressionSupport<SgIorAssignOp>(); break;
4477  case AND: binaryExpressionSupport<SgAndAssignOp>(); break;
4478  case XOR: binaryExpressionSupport<SgXorAssignOp>(); break;
4479  case REMAINDER: binaryExpressionSupport<SgModAssignOp>(); break;
4480  case RIGHT_SHIFT: binaryExpressionSupport<SgRshiftAssignOp>(); break;
4481  case LEFT_SHIFT: binaryExpressionSupport<SgLshiftAssignOp>(); break;
4482 
4483  // This may have to handled special in ROSE. ROSE does not represent the semantics,
4484  // and so this support my require a special operator to support Java in ROSE. For
4485  // now we will use the more common SgRshiftOp.
4486  case UNSIGNED_RIGHT_SHIFT: binaryExpressionSupport<SgJavaUnsignedRshiftAssignOp>(); break;
4487 
4488  default:
4489  //
4490  // If this file was not already tagged as an erroneous file, do so now.
4491  //
4492  if (! ::currentSourceFile -> attributeExists("error")) {
4493  ::currentSourceFile -> setAttribute("error", new AstRegExAttribute("Illegal use of a compound operator"));
4494  }
4495 
4496  cout << "Error: default reached in cactionCompoundAssignmentEnd() operator_kind = " << operator_kind << endl;
4497  cout.flush();
4498  binaryExpressionSupport<SgPlusAssignOp>(); // Any operator so that we can "keep going" !!! EROSE_ASSERT(false);
4499  }
4500 
4501  setJavaSourcePosition((SgLocatedNode *) astJavaComponentStack.top(), env, jToken);
4502 
4503  // Also set the source position of the nested expression in the expression statement.
4504  SgExprStatement *exprStatement = isSgExprStatement(astJavaComponentStack.top());
4505  if (exprStatement != NULL) {
4506  setJavaSourcePosition(exprStatement, env, jToken);
4507  }
4508 }

4651 // DQ (9/5/2011): This was changed to be processed bottom up (so there is no Java_JavaParser_cactionFieldDeclaration() function now.
4652 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionFieldDeclarationEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass,
4653  jstring variable_name,
4654  jint num_annotations,
4655  jboolean is_enum_constant,
4656  jboolean has_initializer,
4657  jboolean is_final,
4658  jboolean is_private,
4659  jboolean is_protected,
4660  jboolean is_public,
4661  jboolean is_volatile,
4662  jboolean is_synthetic,
4663  jboolean is_static,
4664  jboolean is_transient,
4665  jobject jToken) {
4666  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4667  printf ("Inside of Java_JavaParser_cactionFieldDeclarationEnd() \n");
4668 
4669  SgName name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, variable_name);
4670 
4671  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4672  printf ("Building a Field declaration for name = %s \n", name.str());
4673 
4674  SgExpression *initializer_expression = (has_initializer ? astJavaComponentStack.popExpression() : NULL);
4675 
4676  SgScopeStatement *outer_scope = astJavaScopeStack.top();
4677  ROSE_ASSERT(outer_scope);
4678  SgVariableSymbol *symbol = outer_scope -> lookup_variable_symbol(name);
4679  ROSE_ASSERT(symbol);
4680  SgInitializedName *initialized_name = symbol -> get_declaration();
4681  ROSE_ASSERT(initialized_name);
4682  SgVariableDeclaration *variable_declaration = isSgVariableDeclaration(initialized_name -> get_declaration());
4683  ROSE_ASSERT(variable_declaration);
4684 
4685  // By default, the access modifier is set to unknown
4686  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().set_modifier(SgAccessModifier::e_unknown);
4687 
4688  if (is_enum_constant) { // identify ENUM fields
4689  variable_declaration -> setAttribute("enum-constant", new AstRegExAttribute(""));
4690  }
4691  else { // if this is not an ENUM field then it has a type on the stack.
4692  SgType *type = astJavaComponentStack.popType();
4693  ROSE_ASSERT(type);
4694  initialized_name -> setAttribute("type", new AstRegExAttribute(getTypeName(type)));
4695  }
4696 
4697  if (num_annotations > 0) {
4698  AstSgNodeListAttribute *annotations_attribute = new AstSgNodeListAttribute();
4699  for (int i = num_annotations - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
4700  SgExpression *annotation = astJavaComponentStack.popExpression();
4701  annotation -> set_parent(variable_declaration);
4702  annotations_attribute -> setNode(annotation, i);
4703  }
4704  variable_declaration -> setAttribute("annotations", annotations_attribute);
4705  }
4706 
4707  // Set the modifiers (shared between PHP and Java)
4708  if (is_final) {
4709  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().setFinal();
4710  }
4711 
4712  if (is_private) {
4713  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4714  printf ("Setting modifier as Private \n");
4715  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setPrivate();
4716  }
4717 
4718  if (is_protected) {
4719  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4720  printf ("Setting modifier as Protected \n");
4721  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setProtected();
4722  }
4723 
4724  if (is_public) {
4725  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4726  printf ("Setting modifier as Public \n");
4727  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().setPublic();
4728  }
4729 
4730  if (is_volatile) {
4731  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4732  printf ("Setting modifier as Volatile \n");
4733  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_typeModifier().get_constVolatileModifier().setVolatile();
4734  }
4735 
4736  if (is_synthetic) {
4737  // Synthetic is not a keyword, not clear if we want to record this explicitly.
4738  printf ("Specification of isSynthetic is not supported in the IR (should it be?) \n");
4739  }
4740 
4741  if (is_static) {
4742  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4743  printf ("Setting modifier as Static \n");
4744  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_storageModifier().setStatic();
4745  }
4746 
4747  if (is_transient) {
4748  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
4749  printf ("Setting modifier as Transient \n");
4750  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_typeModifier().get_constVolatileModifier().setJavaTransient();
4751  }
4752 
4753  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
4754  variable_declaration -> get_file_info() -> display("source position in Java_JavaParser_cactionFieldDeclarationEnd(): debug");
4755 
4756  if (initializer_expression) { // There is an initialization expression
4757  SgInitializer *initializer = SageBuilder::buildAssignInitializer(initializer_expression);
4758  ROSE_ASSERT(initializer != NULL);
4759

5000 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionForeachStatementEnd(JNIEnv* /*env*/, jclass, jobject /*jToken*/) {

5002  printf ("Inside of Java_JavaParser_cactionForEachStatementEnd() \n");
5003 
5004  SgStatement *action = astJavaComponentStack.popStatement(); // Get the action statement
5005  SgExpression *collection = astJavaComponentStack.popExpression(); // Get the collection expr
5006  SgVariableDeclaration *variable_declaration = isSgVariableDeclaration(astJavaComponentStack.popStatement()); // Get the declaration statement
5007 
5008  // Build the final Foreach Statement
5009  SgJavaForEachStatement *foreach_statement = astJavaScopeStack.popJavaForEachStatement();
5010 
5011  foreach_statement -> set_element(variable_declaration);
5012  variable_declaration -> set_parent(foreach_statement);
5013 
5014  foreach_statement -> set_collection(collection);
5015  collection -> set_parent(foreach_statement);
5016  foreach_statement -> set_loop_body(action);
5017  action -> set_parent(foreach_statement);
5018 
5019  // Pushing 'foreach' on the statement stack
5020  astJavaComponentStack.push(foreach_statement);
5021 }

5126 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionIfStatementEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jboolean has_false_body, jobject jToken) {

5142

5144  if_statement -> set_true_body(true_body);
5145  true_body -> set_parent(if_statement);

5147  SgExpression *condititonal_expression = astJavaComponentStack.popExpression();
5148  SgExprStatement *expression_statement = SageBuilder::buildExprStatement(condititonal_expression);
5149  setJavaSourcePosition(expression_statement, env, jToken); // TODO: copy location from conditional expression instead of jToken!

5151  expression_statement -> set_parent(if_statement);
5152 
5153  astJavaComponentStack.push(if_statement);

5502 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionLocalDeclaration(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jint num_annotations, jstring java_variable_name, jboolean is_final, jobject jToken) {
5503  SgName variable_name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, java_variable_name);
5504 
5505  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
5506  printf ("Inside of Java_JavaParser_cactionLocalDeclaration() for %s\n", variable_name.getString().c_str());
5507 
5508  SgType *type = astJavaComponentStack.popType();
5509  ROSE_ASSERT(type);
5510 
5511  // Note that the type should have already been built and should be on the astJavaComponentStack.
5512  SgVariableDeclaration *variable_declaration = SageBuilder::buildVariableDeclaration(variable_name, type, NULL, astJavaScopeStack.top());
5513  ROSE_ASSERT(variable_declaration != NULL);
5514  variable_declaration -> set_parent(astJavaScopeStack.top());
5515  setJavaSourcePosition(variable_declaration, env, jToken);
5516 
5517  if (is_final) {
5518  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().setFinal();
5519  }
5520 
5521  //
5522  //
5523  //
5524  if (num_annotations > 0) {
5525  AstSgNodeListAttribute *annotations_attribute = new AstSgNodeListAttribute();
5526  for (int i = num_annotations - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
5527  SgExpression *annotation = astJavaComponentStack.popExpression();
5528  annotation -> set_parent(variable_declaration);
5529  annotations_attribute -> setNode(annotation, i);
5530  }
5531  variable_declaration -> setAttribute("annotations", annotations_attribute);
5532  }
5533 
5534  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
5535  printf ("Leaving Java_JavaParser_cactionLocalDeclaration() for %s \n", variable_name.getString().c_str());
5536 }
5537

5539 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionLocalDeclarationEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jstring variable_name, jboolean hasInitializer, jobject jToken) {
5540  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
5541  printf ("Inside of Java_JavaParser_cactionLocalDeclarationEnd() \n");
5542 
5543  SgName name = convertJavaStringToCxxString(env, variable_name);
5544 
5545  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
5546  printf ("Building a local variable declaration for name = %s \n", name.str());
5547 
5548  SgVariableSymbol *variable_symbol = astJavaScopeStack.top() -> lookup_variable_symbol(name);
5549  SgInitializedName *initialized_name = variable_symbol -> get_declaration();
5550  ROSE_ASSERT(initialized_name);
5551  ROSE_ASSERT(initialized_name -> get_scope() != NULL);
5552  initialized_name -> setAttribute("type", new AstRegExAttribute(getTypeName(initialized_name -> get_type())));
5553  setJavaSourcePosition(initialized_name, env, jToken);
5554 
5555  //
5556  //
5557  //
5558  if (hasInitializer) {
5559  SgExpression *initializer_expression = (hasInitializer ? astJavaComponentStack.popExpression() : NULL);
5560 // TODO: Remove this !
5561 /*
5562 cout << "The expression is a "
5563 << initializer_expression -> class_name()
5564 << endl
5565 << "; The top of the stack is a "
5566  << (isSgClassDefinition(astJavaComponentStack.top()) ? isSgClassDefinition(astJavaComponentStack.top()) -> get_qualified_name().getString() : astJavaComponentStack.top() -> class_name())
5567 << endl;
5568 cout.flush();
5569 */
5570  SgAssignInitializer *initializer = SageBuilder::buildAssignInitializer(initializer_expression, initialized_name -> get_type());
5571  ROSE_ASSERT(initializer != NULL);
5572 
5573  setJavaSourcePosition(initializer, env, jToken);
5574  setJavaSourcePosition(initializer_expression, env, jToken);
5575 
5576  initializer_expression -> set_parent(initializer);
5577  initialized_name -> set_initptr(initializer);
5578  initializer -> set_parent(initialized_name);
5579 
5580  ROSE_ASSERT(initializer -> get_parent() != NULL);
5581  ROSE_ASSERT(initializer -> get_parent() == initialized_name);
5582  }
5583 
5584  SgVariableDeclaration *variable_declaration = isSgVariableDeclaration(initialized_name -> get_declaration());
5585  ROSE_ASSERT(variable_declaration != NULL);
5586  // Local declarations have no definition for this (default is NOT public so we need to explicity mark this as unknown).
5587  variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().set_modifier(SgAccessModifier::e_unknown);
5588  ROSE_ASSERT(! variable_declaration -> get_declarationModifier().get_accessModifier().isPublic());
5589 
5590  // Save it on the stack so that we can add SgInitializedNames to it.
5591  astJavaComponentStack.push(variable_declaration);
5592 
5593  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
5594  variable_declaration -> get_file_info() -> display("source position in Java_JavaParser_cactionLocalDeclarationEnd(): debug");
5595 }

5821 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionPostfixExpressionEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jint java_operator_kind, jobject jToken) {
5822  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
5823  printf ("Inside of Java_JavaParser_cactionPostfixExpressionEnd() \n");
5824 
5825  // These are the operator code values directly from ECJ.
5826  enum ops // NO_STRINGIFY
5827  {
5828  ERROR_OPERATOR = 0, // This is not a ECJ value
5829  MINUS = 13,
5830  PLUS = 14,
5831  LAST_OPERATOR
5832  };
5833 
5834  int operator_kind = java_operator_kind;
5835  // printf ("operator_kind = %d \n", operator_kind);
5836 
5837  switch(operator_kind) {
5838  // Operator codes used by the UnaryExpression in ECJ.
5839  case PLUS: unaryExpressionSupport<SgPlusPlusOp>(); break;
5840  case MINUS: unaryExpressionSupport<SgMinusMinusOp>(); break;
5841 
5842  default:
5843  //
5844  // If this file was not already tagged as an erroneous file, do so now.
5845  //
5846  if (! ::currentSourceFile -> attributeExists("error")) {
5847  ::currentSourceFile -> setAttribute("error", new AstRegExAttribute("Illegal use of a postfix operator"));
5848  }
5849 
5850  cout << "Error: default reached in cactionPostfixExpressionEnd() operator_kind = " << operator_kind << endl;
5851  cout.flush();
5852  unaryExpressionSupport<SgPlusPlusOp>(); // Any operator so that we can "keep going" !!! EROSE_ASSERT(false);
5853  }
5854 
5855  // Mark this a a postfix operator
5856  SgUnaryOp *unaryOp = isSgUnaryOp(astJavaComponentStack.top());
5857  ROSE_ASSERT(unaryOp != NULL);
5858  unaryOp -> set_mode(SgUnaryOp::postfix);
5859 
5860  setJavaSourcePosition((SgLocatedNode *) astJavaComponentStack.top(), env, jToken);
5861 }

5917 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionQualifiedAllocationExpressionEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jboolean has_type, jboolean java_contains_enclosing_instance, jint java_num_arguments, jboolean java_is_anonymous, jobject jToken) {
5918  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0)
5919  printf ("Inside of Java_JavaParser_cactionQualifiedAllocationExpressionEnd() \n");

5921  bool contains_enclosing_instance = java_contains_enclosing_instance;

5925  SgClassDeclaration *declaration = isSgClassDeclaration(is_anonymous ? astJavaComponentStack.pop() : NULL);
5926  list<SgExpression*> argument_list;
5927  for (int i = 0; i < num_arguments; i++) { // pop the arguments in reverse order
5928  SgExpression *arg = astJavaComponentStack.popExpression();
5929  argument_list.push_front(arg);
5930  }
5931  vector<SgExpression*> arguments;
5932  while (! argument_list.empty()) { // place the arguments in the vector proper order
5933  arguments.push_back(argument_list.front());
5934  argument_list.pop_front();
5935  }

5938  // A null type indicates that we are dealing with parameters for an Enum constant.
5939  // In such a case, we use the Object type...

5946  SageBuilder::buildExprListExp(arguments),
5947  type,
5948  false,
5949  false,
5950  false,
5951  ! (isSgNamedType(type))); // ! (isSgClassType(type)));

5953 
5954  // TODO: I think a SgJavaParameterizedType should be a SgClassType. Currrently, it is not!
5955 
5956  // For the simple case, we only need the type as input to build SgNewExp.
5957  SgExprListExp *exprListExp = NULL;
5958  SgExpression *expr = NULL;
5959  short int val = 0;
5960  SgFunctionDeclaration *funcDecl = NULL;
5961 
5962  SgNewExp *newExpression = SageBuilder::buildNewExp(type, exprListExp, constInit, expr, val, funcDecl);
5963  ROSE_ASSERT(newExpression != NULL);
5964  constInit -> set_parent(newExpression);
5965 
5966  //
5967  // TODO: Temporary patch until the SgNewExp can handle anonymous types.
5968  //
5969  if (is_anonymous) {
5970  newExpression -> setAttribute("body", new AstSgNodeAttribute(declaration));
5971  }
5972 
5973  setJavaSourcePosition(newExpression, env, jToken);
5974 
5975  SgExpression *result = newExpression;
5976  if (expression_prefix) {
5977  newExpression -> setAttribute("type", new AstRegExAttribute(getUnqualifiedTypeName(type)));

5979  setJavaSourcePosition(result, env, jToken);
5980  }
5981  else {
5982  newExpression -> setAttribute("type", new AstRegExAttribute(getTypeName(type)));
5983  }
5984  astJavaComponentStack.push(result);

6303  // functions should be revisited?

6309 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionSwitchStatementEnd(JNIEnv* /*env*/, jclass, jint numCases, jboolean hasDefaultCase, jobject /*jToken*/) {
6310  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
6311  printf ("Inside of Java_JavaParser_cactionSwitchStatementEnd() \n");
6312 
6313  SgBasicBlock *switch_block = SageBuilder::buildBasicBlock();
6314  switch_block -> set_parent(astJavaScopeStack.top());
6315  ROSE_ASSERT(isSgSwitchStatement(astJavaScopeStack.top()));
6316 
6317  // read 'nb_stmt' elements from the stmt stack
6318  // they should be every direct statement children the block has
6319  SgDefaultOptionStmt *default_stmt = NULL;
6320  for (int i = (hasDefaultCase ? numCases + 1 : numCases); i > 0; i--) {
6321  SgBasicBlock *case_block = SageBuilder::buildBasicBlock();
6322 
6323  SgStatement *sg_stmt = astJavaComponentStack.popStatement();
6324  while (! (isSgCaseOptionStmt(sg_stmt) || isSgDefaultOptionStmt(sg_stmt))) {
6325  case_block -> prepend_statement(sg_stmt);
6326  sg_stmt = astJavaComponentStack.popStatement();
6327  }
6328  case_block -> set_parent(sg_stmt);
6329 
6330  if (isSgCaseOptionStmt(sg_stmt)) {
6331  SgCaseOptionStmt *case_stmt = (SgCaseOptionStmt *) sg_stmt;
6332  case_stmt -> set_body(case_block);
6333  case_stmt -> set_parent(switch_block);
6334  switch_block -> prepend_statement(case_stmt);
6335  }
6336  else {
6337  ROSE_ASSERT(default_stmt == NULL); // only onde default section is expected!
6338  default_stmt = (SgDefaultOptionStmt *) sg_stmt;
6339  default_stmt -> set_body(case_block);
6340  default_stmt -> set_parent(switch_block);
6341  switch_block -> prepend_statement(default_stmt);
6342  }
6343  }
6344 
6345  // Build the final Switch Statement
6346  SgSwitchStatement *switch_statement = astJavaScopeStack.popSwitchStatement();
6347 
6348  // Get the selectorl expression
6349  SgExpression *expr_selector = astJavaComponentStack.popExpression();
6350 
6351  SgExprStatement *item_selector = SageBuilder::buildExprStatement(expr_selector);
6352  item_selector -> set_parent(switch_statement);
6353  switch_statement -> set_item_selector(item_selector);
6354  switch_statement -> set_body(switch_block);
6355 
6356  // Pushing 'switch' on the statement stack
6357  astJavaComponentStack.push(switch_statement);
6358 }

6464 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionTryStatementEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jint num_resources, jint num_catch_blocks, jboolean has_finally_block, jobject jToken) {
6465  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
6466  printf ("Inside of Java_JavaParser_cactionTryStatement() \n");
6467 
6468  SgBasicBlock *finally_body = (SgBasicBlock *) (has_finally_block ? astJavaComponentStack.popStatement() : NULL);
6469  ROSE_ASSERT(finally_body == NULL || isSgBasicBlock(finally_body));
6470 
6471  list<SgCatchOptionStmt *> catches;
6472  for (int i = 0; i < num_catch_blocks; i++) {
6473  SgCatchOptionStmt *catch_option_stmt = (SgCatchOptionStmt *) astJavaComponentStack.popStatement();
6474  ROSE_ASSERT(isSgCatchOptionStmt(catch_option_stmt));
6475  catches.push_front(catch_option_stmt);
6476  }
6477 
6478  SgBasicBlock *try_body = (SgBasicBlock *) astJavaComponentStack.popStatement();
6479  ROSE_ASSERT(isSgBasicBlock(try_body));
6480 
6481  SgTryStmt *try_statement = SageBuilder::buildTryStmt(try_body, finally_body);
6482  setJavaSourcePosition(try_statement, env, jToken);
6483  try_statement -> set_parent(astJavaScopeStack.top());
6484 
6485  if (num_resources > 0) {
6486  AstSgNodeListAttribute *attribute = new AstSgNodeListAttribute();
6487  for (int i = num_resources - 1; i >= 0; i--) { // pop declarations from the stack and place them on the list in proper order.
6488  SgVariableDeclaration *local_declaration = isSgVariableDeclaration(astJavaComponentStack.popStatement());
6489  ROSE_ASSERT(local_declaration);
6490  attribute -> setNode(local_declaration, i);
6491  }
6492  try_statement -> setAttribute("resources", attribute);
6493  }
6494 
6495  //
6496  // charles4 09/23/2011 - Wwhen an SgTryStmt is allocated, its constructor
6497  // preallocates a SgCatchStementSeq (See comment in SageBuilder::buildTryStmt(...))
6498  // for the field p_catch_statement_sequence_root. The position of that field cannot
6499  // be set during the allocation as it was not yet set for the SgTryStmt being allocated.
6500  // Thus, we have to set the location here!
6501  //
6502  SgCatchStatementSeq *catch_statement_sequence = try_statement -> get_catch_statement_seq_root();
6503  setJavaSourcePosition(catch_statement_sequence, env, jToken);
6504 
6505  ROSE_ASSERT(catches.size() == (unsigned) num_catch_blocks);
6506  for (int i = 0; i < num_catch_blocks; i++) {
6507  SgCatchOptionStmt *catch_option_stmt = catches.front();
6508  catches.pop_front();
6509  ROSE_ASSERT(catch_option_stmt);
6510  try_statement -> append_catch_statement(catch_option_stmt);
6511  }
6512 
6513  // Pushing 'try' on the statement stack
6514  astJavaComponentStack.push(try_statement);
6515 }

6524 JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_JavaParser_cactionUnaryExpressionEnd(JNIEnv *env, jclass, jint java_operator_kind, jobject jToken) {
6525  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 2)
6526  printf ("Build an Unary Expression End \n");
6527 
6528  // These are the operator code values directly from ECJ.
6529  enum ops // NO_STRINGIFY
6530  {
6531  ERROR_OPERATOR = 0, // This is not a ECJ value
6532  NOT = 11,
6533  TWIDDLE = 12,
6534  MINUS = 13,
6535  PLUS = 14,
6536  LAST_OPERATOR
6537  };
6538 
6539  int operator_kind = java_operator_kind;
6540  // printf ("operator_kind = %d \n", operator_kind);
6541 
6542  switch(operator_kind) {
6543  // Operator codes used by the UnaryExpression in ECJ.
6544  case NOT: unaryExpressionSupport<SgNotOp>(); break;
6545  case TWIDDLE: unaryExpressionSupport<SgBitComplementOp>(); break;
6546  case MINUS: unaryExpressionSupport<SgMinusOp>(); break;
6547  case PLUS: unaryExpressionSupport<SgUnaryAddOp>(); break;
6548 
6549  default:
6550  //
6551  // If this file was not already tagged as an erroneous file, do so now.
6552  //
6553  if (! ::currentSourceFile -> attributeExists("error")) {
6554  ::currentSourceFile -> setAttribute("error", new AstRegExAttribute("Illegal use of a unary operator"));
6555  }
6556 
6557  cout << "Error: default reached in cactionUnaryExpressionEnd() operator_kind = " << operator_kind << endl;
6558  cout.flush();
6559  unaryExpressionSupport<SgUnaryAddOp>(); // Any operator so that we can "keep going" !!! EROSE_ASSERT(false);
6560  }
6561 
6562  setJavaSourcePosition((SgLocatedNode *) astJavaComponentStack.top(), env, jToken);
6563 }
